organization: Society for Decision Making Under Deep Uncertainty (DMDU Society)
field: decision making under deep uncertainty, water resources planning
public_contact_or_submission: public Join Us and Get Involved routes on the society site
why_relevant: the field's own professional body; defines deep uncertainty as disagreement about system model, probability distributions and consequences, and explicitly invites policy makers, analysts and researchers
notes: use the public opt-in routes; no personal emails; membership is not evidence of agreement

field: deep uncertainty methods, water case studies
public_contact_or_submission: public meeting pages and registration route
why_relevant: past meetings hosted with the US Bureau of Reclamation and universities; ground-visible presentation route
notes: check current meeting dates; abstracts and materials are public

organization: US Bureau of Reclamation, Research and Development Office
field: water resources, climate uncertainty, long term planning
public_contact_or_submission: public contact form published on the agency site
why_relevant: co-producer of the Water Planning for the Uncertain Future DMDU tool; a real agency with a ground in reservoir and basin operations
notes: form is public and not confidential; do not send anything you need protected

organization: US Bureau of Reclamation prize competitions
field: water management innovation, subsurface detection, invasive species
public_contact_or_submission: public challenge and prize competition portal

notes: check current challenge topics; entry is public and competitive

organization: RAND, Water Planning for the Uncertain Future
type: public decision-support tool and research publisher
field: water resources planning under deep uncertainty

notes: use the tool and RAND public channels; not a submission venue for a claim
